name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(at_exit, holding_box) is an added requirement. The task says 'Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again' — the 'whenever' covers only the box falling, not reaching the exit. The carry-to-exit requirement is already expressed by Existence(at_exit) together with Response(box_fell, holding_box); Response(at_exit, holding_box) does not trace to any sentence and effectively adds a duplicate 'hold box at exit' condition. Remove Response(at_exit, holding_box); keep Existence(at_exit) and Response(box_fell, holding_box).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) hard captures the goal of reaching the exit, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) hard captures 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' — a lasting condition (holding_box) responding to a one-step event (box_fell), which closes correctly when the agent picks the box up. Both clauses trace to the task with correct priorities.
